name: gemini-media
description: Plan, generate, and edit images and video with Gemini, Veo, and Omni, with cost estimates before generation.

data_folder.title: Media output folder
data_folder.description: Absolute path to a writable folder for images and videos, outside Claude's plugin cache. Local media inputs must also be inside this folder.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Required for Gemini API mode. Leave blank for Vertex AI unless you also want Gemini API access for Omni.

use_vertex.title: Use Vertex AI
use_vertex.description: Enable for Veo and Vertex AI features, then set the project and credentials below. Otherwise use the Gemini API key.

google_cloud_project.title: Google Cloud project
google_cloud_project.description: Project ID for Vertex AI. Leave blank in Gemini API mode.

google_cloud_location.title: Vertex AI location
google_cloud_location.description: Google Cloud region for Vertex AI.

google_application_credentials.title: Vertex AI service account file
google_application_credentials.description: Absolute path to a service account JSON file. Leave blank to use Application Default Credentials, or when using the Gemini API.

video_gcs_bucket.title: Video GCS bucket
video_gcs_bucket.description: Optional gs://bucket for large video output on Vertex AI. Also seeds the bucket allowlist unless GCS_ALLOWED_BUCKETS is set.

omni_backend.title: Omni backend
omni_backend.description: Auto prefers the Gemini API whenever an API key is configured. Choose vertex to keep Omni usage in your Vertex project.
